description:
Return an operational snapshot of a site derived from real scan, cookie, and banner state.

Args:
  - id (string): The site id.

Returns JSON: { websiteId, domain, status, lastScan, bannerConfigured, scan:{cookiesFound,scriptsFound}, cookies:{total}, categories:{total,enabled}, warnings:string[] }. scriptsFound is null: not measured in the stored website snapshot.
Warning codes: scan_zero_with_inventory = last scan found zero but auto-detected inventory remains, possible scan failure, rescan recommended (not proof of failure); scan_stale = lastScan older than 30 days; never_scanned = lastScan is null; banner_not_configured = no banner configuration. An empty warnings array is not proof of legal compliance.
pending = awaiting a completed scan; scanning = in progress; compliant = scan completed successfully; attention = scan failed or review needed. These stored statuses must be interpreted with warnings and lastScan, not used as a legal verdict.

IMPORTANT: this is operational status only. It is NOT legal advice and NOT a guarantee of GDPR/CCPA compliance — do not present it as one. Requires scope: sites:read.
name: consentease_get_compliance_report
title: Get a site's compliance snapshot
